videos.title: Resumen del fútbol
videos.script:
¡Bienvenidos a Fútbol al Minuto!
Resumen del fútbol.

Joint-record six referee errors in last Premier League weekend.
The Premier League's Key Match Incidents Panel rules there were six on-field errors in the last round of games - the joint-highest in one weekend.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

The 3pm football blackout: Outdated or still relevant in 2026?.
After 60 years, is time finally running out on the 3pm blackout in football?
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Former Spain midfielder Mata retires aged 38.
Former Spain midfielder Juan Mata, who had spells at Chelsea and Manchester United in the Premier League, announces his retirement from playing at the age of 38.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Toney loses bid to avoid Euro 2028 court clash.
Ivan Toney's trial, for an alleged assault which he denies, is due to take place during the Euro 2028 tournament.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Record crowds, legends - Bordeaux bid to escape amateur game.
Bordeaux fans thought things could not get any worse, then they were demoted to France's amateur sixth tier.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Actualidad internacional.

From one of Ajax's future stars to quitting football for music.
Former Ajax academy player Elikia Mbinga tells BBC Sport how he swapped football for music after playing with some Premier League stars.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Israel row a 'defining moment for us' - Hallgrimsson.
Republic of Ireland manager Heimir Hallgrimsson says the controversy surrounding the Nations League games against Israel has made "this group stronger".
Fuente: BBC Sport.

NI will carry momentum into Euro 2028 qualifiers.
Northern Ireland manager Michael O'Neill says his Nations League promotion winners will plot their next 12 months after the Euro 2028 qualifying draw in December.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Liverpool lead Chelsea in Camara race - Wednesday's gossip.
Liverpool leading Chelsea in race for Monaco's Lamine Camara, Barcelona rule out moves for Virgil van Dijk and Bruno Fernandes, and ex-Crystal Palace winger Wilfried Zaha could rejoin the club.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Bellamy convinced of Wales credentials despite defeat by Portugal.
Wales finished bottom of their Nations League group, but boss Craig Bellamy believes his team showed they belong in the top flight.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Últimas noticias del fútbol.

Republic of Ireland talisman Parrott caps dream year with two more goals.
Republic of Ireland striker Troy Parrott reflects on a transformative 12 months for both club and country after scoring a double in the win against Kosovo.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes.
Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Arsenal Double winner Storey dies aged 81.
Former Arsenal and England midfielder Peter Storey - who helped the Gunners win the Double in 1970-71 - has died at the age of 81.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Manchester won't always be blue - Pochettino.
New Manchester United boss Mauricio Pochettino says he will restore Manchester United to being the most successful footballing side in the city.
Fuente: BBC Sport.

Williams to join temporary Swansea coaching team.
Ashley Williams is set to join a temporary Swansea City coaching team as the Championship club attempt to fill the void left by Vitor Matos.
Fuente: BBC Sport.
